note: All 78 street lines of the blog post 'Decommunization of Tbilisi toponymy' (kvamli.wordpress.com, 2021-12-12, 'renamed in 1987-1991') with the state of the check as of 2026-11-22. The owner confirmed that all the listed renamings took place. Names, years and quotes are checked against the text of the ka.wikipedia pages (the quotes of Gemini were compared with the page text). status: done = in site/data/street_names.json; on_site = already there before; postponed = see reason; no_start = the page gives the year of the renaming but not of the old name; no_year = no page gives a year yet. Archil Tsagareli Street (n=33, formerly Kronshtadtskaya): the blog confirms the name pair, no page gives a year; an archive request is needed. Source of the list: https://kvamli.wordpress.com/2021/12/12/%E1%83%97%E1%83%91%E1%83%98%E1%83%9A%E1%83%98%E1%83%A1%E1%83%98%E1%83%A1-%E1%83%A2%E1%83%9D%E1%83%9E%E1%83%9D%E1%83%9C%E1%83%98%E1%83%9B%E1%83%98%E1%83%99%E1%83%98%E1%83%A1-%E1%83%93%E1%83%94%E1%83%99/ Round two (Gemini, 2026-11-22): see round2 fields; status dates_found_not_yet_added = a page confirms both years, the street is not on the site yet. For the other lines no ka.wikipedia page gives years; the matsne.gov.ge portal has no acts of 1988-1991 in text form; the years are in the printed encyclopedia 'Tbilisi: streets, avenues, squares' (2008) or in the files of the Tbilisi executive committee. Round three (2026-11-22): the owner pointed to ru.wikipedia (category 'Улицы Тбилиси, названные в честь людей', 82 articles; only a few match the pending streets and they mostly give no years). Round four (2026-11-22): Gemini's report was verified against the text of the encyclopedia 'Tbilisi: streets, avenues, squares' (2008), the PDF obtained by the owner (data/cache/nplg_pdfs, not committed); status verified_enc2008_not_yet_added = the book text confirms the years, the street is not on the site yet.
